installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# BeamMP server installation (runs in the Debian installer container).
# Downloads the BeamMP-Server binary matching the runtime image (Debian 12)
# and creates a default ServerConfig.toml only if none exists, so that a
# reinstall updates the server without touching its config or resources.
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
    aarch64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *)       ARCH=x86_64 ;;
esac
ASSET="BeamMP-Server.debian.12.${ARCH}"

if [ "${VERSION:-latest}" = "latest" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/BeamMP/BeamMP-Server/releases/latest/download/${ASSET}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/BeamMP/BeamMP-Server/releases/download/${VERSION}/${ASSET}"
fi

echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o BeamMP-Server.new "${URL}"
chmod +x BeamMP-Server.new
mv -f BeamMP-Server.new BeamMP-Server

mkdir -p Resources/Client Resources/Server

if [ ! -f ServerConfig.toml ]; then
    cat > ServerConfig.toml <<'EOF'
# BeamMP-Server config file. Most values are managed from the panel's
# Startup tab and rewritten on every start.
# Documentation: https://docs.beammp.com/server/server-maintenance/

[General]
Name = "BeamMP Server"
Description = "BeamMP Server"
Port = 30814
AuthKey = ""
Private = true
MaxCars = 1
MaxPlayers = 8
Map = "/levels/gridmap_v2/info.json"
Tags = "Freeroam"
AllowGuests = true
LogChat = true
Debug = false
ResourceFolder = "Resources"
IP = "::"
InformationPacket = true

[Misc]
ImScaredOfUpdates = false
UpdateReminderTime = "30d"
EOF
fi

echo "BeamMP server installed."
